description: Spectrum TG40SE Self-Propelled Petrol Lawnmower with Electric Start
marketingText: If you're looking for an affordable yet high-quality petrol lawnmower for a smaller garden, the Spectrum TG40SE 16″ Self-Propelled Petrol Lawnmower is an excellent choice. Designed for ease of use and efficiency, this mower features a durable steel deck, a reliable petrol engine, and a convenient electric key start - all at a budget-friendly price. Hassle-Free Electric Start with Backup Pull-Start No more struggling with pull cords - start the TG40SE effortlessly with the turn of a key. The electric start system ensures quick and reliable ignition, making mowing more convenient than ever. For added peace of mind, a manual recoil start is included as a backup, so you can always get mowing even if the battery isn't charged. Self-Propelled for Smooth, Effortless Mowing Tackling inclines, uneven terrain, or overgrown grass is easy with the self-propelled drive system, which takes the effort out of mowing. This feature ensures a consistent, controlled pace, reducing fatigue and making lawn care more enjoyable. Customizable Cutting Heights for a Perfect Lawn The five-position height adjustment allows you to set the cutting height between 25mm and 65mm, giving you full control over your lawn's appearance. Whether you prefer a short, manicured finish or a longer cut for thicker grass, the TG40SE adapts to seasonal changes with ease. Compact, User-Friendly Design Foldable, ergonomic handlebar for comfortable operation and easy storage. 40-litre grass collector with a breathable fabric design for improved collection efficiency. Hard-top grass bag minimizes pollen emissions, making it a great choice for hay fever sufferers. Built for Durability and Performance Strong steel cutting deck for a rugged, long-lasting build. Large rear wheels enhance traction, making it easier to navigate through thick or damp grass. Ball-bearing wheel mounts ensure smooth movement and longevity, outperforming standard bush-mounted wheels. 3-in-1 Cutting System: Collection, Side Discharge & Mulching The versatile cutting options make this mower ideal for different lawn conditions: ✔ Grass Collection - Keep your lawn tidy with the 40L collector, reducing the need for frequent emptying. ✔ Side Discharge - Perfect for longer, overgrown grass, this function spreads clippings evenly to prevent clumps, making it ideal for orchards, paddocks, and wildflower meadows. ✔ Mulching - Improve lawn health naturally by chopping grass clippings into fine pieces and redistributing them as a nutrient-rich fertilizer that retains moisture, suppresses weeds, and promotes greener growth. The Ideal Petrol Lawnmower for Small to Medium Gardens Whether you need a self-propelled mower for a compact lawn or a versatile cutting system for varying conditions, the Spectrum TG40SE 16" Petrol Key Start Lawn Mower delivers exceptional reliability, ease of use, and performance - all at an outstanding value.

description: Spectrum SBS220CHM 22cm Cordless Handy Mower - Bare Tool (Battery & Charger Sold Separately)
marketingText: Spectrum SBS220CHM - The Mower That Goes Where Others Can't Small lawns, awkward corners, tight edges around borders and obstacles - the Spectrum SBS220CHM Cordless Handy Mower is built for exactly these situations. At just 3.8kg, it's one of the lightest cordless mowers you'll find, and its compact 22cm cutting deck lets you work into spaces that a full-size mower can't reach. Despite its compact dimensions, the SBS220CHM doesn't compromise on quality. A high-efficiency brushless motor provides reliable performance, longer battery life per charge, and less ongoing maintenance than a brushed equivalent. Spinning at 6,000rpm, it cuts cleanly and consistently across the cutting height range. Three central height settings from 30mm to 50mm let you adapt to the season and your lawn's condition. The built-in mulching function returns finely chopped clippings directly to the lawn - feeding the soil and eliminating the need to collect and dispose of grass waste. The flexible handle folds down for compact storage, and the balanced weight distribution makes it easy to lift over steps, carry between areas, or store vertically in a shed or cupboard. Tool-only model. Compatible with Spectrum 2.0Ah and 4.0Ah batteries and all Spectrum 40V chargers, all available separately.

description: Spectrum SBS460CLM 46cm Self-Propelled Cordless Lawn Mower - Bare Tool (Batteries & Charger Sold Separately)
marketingText: Spectrum SBS460CLM - The Cordless Mower Built for Real Lawns If your lawn demands more than a basic push-along can deliver, the Spectrum SBS460CLM is where performance meets practicality. Engineered for medium to large gardens, this self-propelled cordless mower takes the hard work out of lawn care - you guide it, and the transmission does the rest. At the heart of the SBS460CLM is a high-efficiency brushless motor drawing power from a dual-battery configuration. This twin-battery setup doesn't just extend your runtime - it maintains consistent cutting speed from the first strip to the last, even in thicker grass. The 46cm (18") metal cutting deck covers ground quickly without compromising finish quality. Seven central cutting heights from 25mm to 75mm let you dial in the perfect cut for the season - scalp-close in spring, or a lush longer finish in the summer heat. Adjustment takes seconds with the single central lever. When it comes to grass disposal, the SBS460CLM gives you four options: rear collection into the 60-litre grass bag, mulching back into the lawn, rear discharge, or side discharge. A bag-full indicator means no blockages, no guesswork. Large ball-bearing wheels - 7" front and 10" rear - roll smoothly across uneven ground and resist turf damage. Despite a solid, substantial build, the mower remains well-balanced and manageable throughout your session. This is a tool-only model. Compatible with optional Spectrum 2Ah and 4Ah batteries. Choose from standard, fast, or dual charger options - all available separately.
